# Python tools used by CI, pinned so CI and laptops run the same versions.
# Install locally with: python -m pip install -r .github/ci-requirements.txt
# asset/metadata tools the SDK's CMake calls
32blit==0.7.4
# 32blit 0.7.4 imports ConstBitStream, which bitstring 5.0 removed
bitstring<5
# same formatter version everywhere; a different version can format differently
clang-format==23.1.3
